# TensionResolveRequest

Resolves an open tension between two threads.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resolution` | `string` | yes | How the tension was settled, in your own words. Constraints: maxLength: 2000, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |

## Example

```json
{
  "resolution": "..."
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`looms.resolveTension`](../api/looms.md) (`PUT /looms/by-id/{id}/tensions/by-id/{tensionId}/resolve`)
